standard_prerequisites.use: Gives etaleness of the base-changed morphism at the point.

core_obligations: Reduce to the open locus: for a flat finitely presented morphism there is a maximal open subspace over which it is etale, whose formation commutes with representable base change, so it suffices to show that the point lies in it (proof lines 4566-4575)

Apply the criterion: the base-changed morphism is flat and locally of finite presentation and unramified at the point by hypothesis, so the flat-unramified-finitely-presented criterion makes it etale there (proof lines 4576-4582)
proof_roadmap: 对平坦有限表现态射有「étale 的最大开子空间 W(f)」，且其形成与可表示基变换交换。
故只需证该点在 W(f) 中；而 F → Spec(k) 平坦、局部有限表现且在 z 处 unramified ⇒ 由对应判据在该点 étale。
difficulty_reason: The counted statement shows that a morphism which is flat and locally of finite presentation and unramified at a point of the fibre over a field becomes etale after shrinking the source to an open subspace containing that point (author lemma at source lines 4547-4564, label lemma-etale-at-point). The proof (source lines 4566-4583) uses the maximal open subspace on which the morphism is etale and its compatibility with base change to reduce to the corresponding criterion for the base-changed morphism (proof lines 4566-4582). The reduction through the maximal etale locus is the substance. H3.
